name: Phoenix Style (Combat, Style)
body:
You mastered the secrets of fire to heal yourself and burn your foes.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, Elemental Fist, Improved Unarmed Strike , base attack bonus +9 or monk level 5th.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional Elemental Fist attempt per day. While you are in this style, your Elemental Fist attack deals fire damage.

When you are the target of a fire attack while using this style, you don’t suffer damage and are instead healed by 1 hp for every dice of damage the attack would have dealt.
